unit: Windows physical stat and readlink consume the single binding namespace conversion

edits.before:
/// Actual FOLLOWED metadata or the owned system failure, before any handle or
/// path cleanup can replace thread-local error state. This byte-only producer
/// Separate no-follow status; it cannot be passed as a FollowResult by mistake.
edits.after:
/// Separate no-follow status for a binding-prepared path; it cannot be passed
/// as a FollowResult by mistake. Windows input is already namespaced.

edits.before:
/// Actual readlink operation with owned target storage and latched raw status.
/// Handles never escape the synchronous native owner.

cause.observed: V24 classic physical paths fail during lstat of C:\ with EISDIR; CommonJS helper control 18 fails in the same real native filesystem path.
cause.source_inference: The actual binding already applies ToNamespacedPath once. Both physical leaves applied it again. For an already namespaced drive-root path, the second native path resolution removes the root's final separator and selects the volume path. The physical stat fallback then reaches the retained INVALID_FUNCTION-to-EISDIR mapping.
cause.correction: The physical status APIs explicitly accept binding-prepared Windows input. They now convert those same bytes to UTF-16 directly; the single original binding conversion remains before the OS request and error construction.

caller_inventory.scope: Complete Main src tree, literal status API names and direct Windows leaf import

owned_tree.scope: Complete current owned src tree, including the uncommitted CJS stat draft

remaining: This source correction does not establish runtime success. The distinct classic original-argument fixture failures and Helpers Source opcode retirement failures have separate correction owners.

finite_peer.scope: Exact two physical deltas against complete Main preimages; actual Node Stat/LStat/ReadLink, PathResolve/ToNamespacedPath and libuv stat preparation; all four current owned callers already provide prepared paths; unchanged handle/status/retry/readlink cleanup.
